name: Trued, Headlamp
tagline: The family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram, with the Next up tube standing at full height as the line's lit head, graphite plates, one lit strip for the month and a spend meter on the glass.
concept: Trued, Headlamp keeps Trued's line language (a line starts at a terminus and ends at a T buffer, ring stops, one lamp at now) and makes the Next up tube the line's lit head: it stands at full height, 4:3, on Coming up's rail like the lamp on a train, its power wire dropping from its chin onto its own stop, the run lit from the now lamp through it to the second stop and steel after. The greeting asks 'Tell Vera what needs a plan.' at 3rem over a box the board's height, with the steel branch of starters saying where each usually lands. Rails go only where there is an order: the month is a grid again with one strip of glass drawing it as a single track, Ideas gets its line from home in drive order, and Status leads with a moving-coil meter on its glass. It should feel like a signal box at night: graphite plates and slate, one lamp lit where you are about to act.
companions: Steel #9cc3dd is the wiring and the family's hand: rails, the starter branch and its stops, the setup stub's rings, links, the family's chat edge, the row afterglow's 12% wash. Graphite #15191a (chroma under 0.01) with a #2c3336 hairline is a plan's plate wherever one is drawn (Home's plates, the month's cells) and the family's chat bubble; navy and the cyan caps are gone. Cyan #74e6f0 lives only in the plan rings (a kind ring on a plate, the ring before a plan day's numeral) and the date chips' month. Kind rings keep grounded hues (terracotta, moss, wheat, lemon, lilac, pink). Amber means late or needs a look: the late words, the half lamps, and one 6px lamp beside 'Finish setting up'. Sage #86d9a6 is the afterglow's edge, so a pointed row never reads as live. #6dff9c is the signature where the motif needs it: the mark, Send, 'plan', the box being written in, the junction lamp, focus rings, the now lamps and lit runs, the tube's power wire, the next setup stop, today's cell on the month, and the glass of every tube.
decisions: Title: 'Tell Vera what needs a *plan*.' (the box's label, Home's largest head, at clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3rem), Archivo 700 at 88% width, balanced; 'plan' carries E1 with a hot core and the full stop is in the title's own run). It joins the imperative that won heat b ('Tell Vera what to plan.': it names who hears you and invites telling) with the reach of 'What needs planning?' (it cannot be answered 'no', and it takes in reminders and wishes as well as weekends), and keeps a four-letter lit word at the line's end so the halo stays modest.

Coming up: the tube stands 21.5rem wide at 4:3 on the rail, flush with the band's left edge, the now lamp at its left foot in the tube's own column, so the run leaves the lamp straight under the glass. Its plan is at the top of the glass, '› 3 more on the line' at its foot like a terminal's prompt, the radar as tall as the words. A 2px power wire, lit as the mark is (E2: a white core, then 6, 14 and 26px of phosphor), drops 1.6rem from its chin to its stop. The run is lit from now through the tube's stop to Mount St. Helens, then steel to a T buffer; the days hang under the rail.

The heading stands beside the tube, over the plates: 'Coming up 4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00', the one-line Google note and 'All plans'. At 64rem and over the plates stretch from under the head to the rail, so the tube and the plates stand on the rail together and no slate band is left between head and plates; the height goes to the name, at 21px Archivo 700, 88% width, balanced, with whom and the well pinned to the foot. On a phone the head comes first.

Plates are graphite #15191a with a #2c3336 hairline, no cap: kind ring and word, the name, then whom beside the sunk time well on one line. A template macro (nb) binds short abbreviations and initials to their neighbours with no-break spaces, so 'Mount St. Helens' never breaks inside itself; in the repository it is a views.py filter.
The plate's foot now fits whom and the well on one line at 1280, because the stretched plate is wider than the earlier stacked one.

Setup (Quote Board's one-line fold, rebuilt): one 60px band on the slate tray: a 6px amber lamp and 'Finish setting up', a steel stub of three numbered ring stops with step 1 lit #6dff9c, step 1's link in full, 'then Telegram · Google Calendar' as words in --ink-3, a buffer and 'All 3 steps →'. No amber outline or fill. The numbered stops are 1.35rem rather than the brief's 0.875rem, because a DM Mono figure inside a 14px ring is under 10px.

Plans month (Desk Terminal's plan trace, rebuilt as one track): the week rails are gone and the grid is a grid. Today's cell has a 1px #6dff9c outline with E4 and a lit 'now'; a plan day has a cyan ring before its numeral. Above the grid a scanlined strip of glass draws the month as one track and keeps the line's own rule of one lamp: the now lamp breathes at today with 'now' set over it, the run is lit to the next plan only, and that plan's ring carries the run's light. The plans further on are dim phosphor rings (55%, no halo), those gone by fainter (26%). Day numerals are 12.5px DM Mono on odd days only, and always on today and in the plan rings. Month titles in cells are balanced and pass through the same nb binding as Home's plates, so 'rink' is never left alone and 'Mount St. Helens' never breaks.

Ideas: the line from home is back over the table at the board's width. Home is a lit terminus; each listed place is a ring stop (steel on the glass) at its true drive on a log scale, with mileposts at 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h and 3 h under the rail, so the four long drives sit visibly far down the line. Each station's number (the row's No.) stands over it on a short steel leader, fanned out where places crowd (six fall between 18 and 27 minutes, two at 21), so no two numbers meet. The numbers are dim phosphor; only home, the run and the nearest stop are lit, and pointing at a row lights its station. The caption keeps the parent's words ('The line from home · 10 places · minutes by road', and Nearest and Furthest as links to their rows), and the blinking block is gone: it is a map, not a prompt.

Status (Desk Terminal's moving-coil meter, redrawn): an arc on a square-root scale, so the first eighth of the limit takes a third of the sweep, with VT323 labels at 0, $0.25, $1.00 and $2.00, minor ticks, a dashed hot tick at the limit and a dashed ghost needle on the average day of the last 30 days, which now stands well clear of zero. The needle is one 2px hot line under a soft two-step halo, pivoting on a visible hub cap inside the glass, and kicks and settles as the tube warms. 'SPENT TODAY, ABOUT $0.00' sits in the glass's top corner and the case's power lamp breathes. The lamp banks are centred in their well under a steel hairline. The tally and Who answers are unchanged.

The row afterglow (Quote Board's, rebuilt): a 12% steel wash, a 2px sage inset edge and an 18px soft halo, on in 0.12s and fading over 1.4s, on the plates, To do rows, Ideas rows, Lately added rows, Settings rows, the month's plans and the starter keys (whose ring stop lights too); instant with reduced motion. It shows in stills: the capture's pointer left it on a plate and a To do row.

To do, Home and page: the margin is the date only, a figure then 'Oct' over 'Sun', in DM Mono at one size in --ink-3; an hour is printed only when it is a set one (on the quarter hour), so the seeded '19:56' is gone. The Home margin narrowed to 4.4rem and its gutter widened to 1.25rem.

Starters carry a quiet second line, 'usually lands in Plans', 'in To do', 'in Ideas' (13px, --ink-3), on the phone too. 'Or start with' is the branch's label at its junction (DM Sans 600, 13px, --ink-2). On a phone the greeting is shorter (title 2rem, the box sized to its words), and 'who is asking?' has the row's width with the mic beside it, its chevron 0.6rem in from 2.25rem of right padding.
The bar has a Home key with the house icon before Vera, as on the phone's tab bar.
Chat: the family's bubbles move from navy #1b2531 to graphite #1b2124 with their steel edge, so navy is nowhere on the page.

First screen at 1280x900: the greeting, Coming up and the setup line close by 840px, and the To do and Lately added heads stand on the first screen. On the phone, Coming up's head and the top of the tube's glass (NEXT UP and the plan's name) show above the tab bar.

STYLE notes (in headlamp.css's header, so the system holds on pages the sheets do not show): --plate graphite #15191a with a #2c3336 hairline for every plan's plate; section.setup-line as the one form for what waits on an admin; one lamp per line or strip, every other stop a ring (steel on slate, 55% phosphor on glass, fainter once gone by); the spend meter's square-root scale; numerals on glass 12px at least.

Declined: moving the plates' kind and whom, Home's deadlines, the nb filter and the set-hour rule into views.py, and a real 'time was set' field. A variant may only replace templates, not views.py or the schema, so they stay in the templates, marked where they belong. The quarter-hour test stays as the stand-in; in the repository it would be a due_time_set column on tasks. Also declined, as already met: the To do margin's figure is already DM Mono at the size of 'Sep'/'Sun' in --ink-3, with the same 1.25rem gutter as the To do page.
strengths: The tube is the hero and is joined to the line: flush on the band, the now lamp at its foot, a lit wire to its stop, a run two stops long, and the plates standing on the rail beside it. Coming up reads as one drawn thing at a glance.
One lamp per line holds everywhere: Home's line, the month strip (today only, plans as dim rings), the line from home (home and the nearest) and Who answers.
Every page has one lit instrument that draws its own data: the tube on Home, the month track on Plans, the line from home on Ideas, and a spend meter on Status that reads as a meter, not a stripe.
The Ideas strip now does its job: true drive distance on a log scale, so the day trips sit far down the line, with numbers fanned so none collide.
Navy is gone (graphite plates and bubbles); amber is one 6px lamp and words; setup is one line. 0 targets under 44px on every page, nothing under 13px, no sideways scroll.
weaknesses: The stretched plates keep some empty graphite between the name and the foot when a name is short; it reads as a plate's margin, but it is space without content.

Template logic the repository would put in views.py (the plates' kind and whom, Home's deadlines, the nb filter, the set-hour rule) is still in the templates, and the quarter-hour test is still a guess at which times were set.
On Status the meter's case is taller than the banks need, so the well has dark space above and below them.
The month strip is left out on a phone, and the phone shows only the top of the tube above the tab bar.
Ideas' words still differ from today's by about a third (the parent's line-from-home wording), and Home adds the new title, the 'lands in' lines and the shorter Google note.
The harness's pointer, left where the sign-in button was, lights one starter on the phone still; it is hover, not a default.
revisions: Status meter redrawn: a square-root scale (an eighth of the limit takes a third of the sweep), one 2px hot needle with a soft halo on a visible hub inside the glass (the separate tip and the striped stack are gone), labels at 0, $0.25, $1.00 and $2.00, and the ghost needle at the average day now clear of zero. The banks sit centred under a steel hairline.

Month strip: one lamp. Plan rings are dim phosphor (55%, no halo), past ones 26%, only the next plan's ring carries the run's light; 'now' is set over the lamp, so nothing collides at the start; numerals are 12.5px on odd days plus today and the plan days.

Coming up (option b): the tube is flush with the band's left, the now lamp at its foot in its own column; the plates stretch from under the head to the rail with the name at 21px Archivo and whom and the well pinned to the foot, so there is no dead slate band; the power wire is longer (1.6rem) and E2-lit.

Ideas: ring stops instead of bars, at true log drive distance with mileposts under the rail, numbers fanned on leaders so none collide, dim phosphor numbers with only home, the run and the nearest lit; the blinking block is gone and the parent's caption words, with Nearest and Furthest, are back.
Phone: the 'lands in' lines stay; the greeting is shorter (2rem title, the box sized to its words with no scroll arrows), so Coming up's head and the tube's top show above the tab bar.

Month cells balance their titles and bind 'St.' to its neighbours (the nb macro, as on Home); the STYLE notes are written into the sheet's header (graphite plate token, setup line, one-lamp rule, meter scale, glass numerals).

Declined: moving template logic into views.py and a real 'time was set' field (a variant cannot change views.py or the schema; noted where each belongs). Checked and already met: the To do margin is one face and size, the select's focus ring is restored, the phone chevron has its padding, and the row afterglow (12% steel wash, 2px sage edge, 18px halo, on :hover and :has(:focus-visible), instant under reduced motion) shows in the controls strip on a Lately added row.
